summary: The layout adapts well to RTL with appropriate calendar column mirroring, clean spacing, and legible typography, showing only minor BiDi punctuation artifacts in English text.

issues.title: BiDi punctuation flipping in English copy
issues.description: English description strings inside RTL containers display periods at the wrong visual end of lines.
issues.evidence: Periods appear at the left side of text lines under Booking rules (e.g., '.session' and '.manual review').
issues.suggestion: Wrap English strings in dir='ltr' or use unicode isolation.
